name: Photo Synth (HTML)
description: The same idea in a browser tab, with the things only a browser can do. Play four photos: colour becomes tone, in mono, unison or four-note polyphony, through a filter, an envelope and an FX photo whose red, green and blue strengths drive three chosen effects. Seven switchable stereo effects, on-device presets with photo snapshots, motion automation, a live camera, a hardware MIDI keyboard and 24-bit WAV export. Nothing to install and nothing uploaded anywhere.
note: Also available as a native VST3 plugin. On iPhone, sound follows the ring/silent switch.
